content: At Global Institute of Medical Science & Health Care, we recognize our responsibility towards the communities in which we operate. Our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) initiatives are undertaken with the objective of contributing to positive and lasting social impact while supporting the broader needs of society.

Our CSR Policy provides a framework for identifying, planning, implementing and monitoring CSR initiatives in accordance with the applicable provisions of the Companies Act, 2013 and the Companies (Corporate Social Responsibility Policy) Rules, 2014, as amended from time to time.
- Provide a framework for undertaking CSR initiatives in accordance with applicable regulations.
- Ensure effective implementation and reporting of CSR initiatives.
- Encourage employee participation in CSR activities.
- Create positive and sustainable social impact through community-focused initiatives.
The organization may undertake CSR projects and programmes falling within the activities specified under Schedule VII of the Companies Act, 2013, including:
- Eradication of hunger, poverty and malnutrition.
- Promotion of healthcare, preventive healthcare and sanitation.
- Safe drinking water and sanitation initiatives.
- Promotion of education and special education.
- Employment-enhancing vocational skills and livelihood enhancement.
- Support for senior citizens and socially and economically disadvantaged groups.
- Protection of national heritage, art and culture.
- Support for armed forces veterans, war widows and their dependents.
- Promotion of rural, national and recognized sports, including Paralympic and Olympic sports.
- Contributions towards eligible relief and welfare funds.
- Other sustainable development initiatives based on community needs, as permitted under applicable law.

The CSR Policy gives preference to the local area and areas surrounding the organization’s operations. The Policy specifically identifies **Jabalpur and nearby villages in Madhya Pradesh** as the preferred geographical area for CSR activities, while permitting the Board/Committee to identify other areas as appropriate.

CSR activities are undertaken as projects or programmes, including new and ongoing initiatives, in accordance with the applicable CSR framework. Projects may be implemented directly by the organization or through specialized agencies with an established track record in the CSR field.
The CSR budget is determined for each financial year, with provisions for planning, implementation, monitoring and, where applicable, impact assessment of CSR projects.
For transparency and statutory disclosure, the organization makes available its CSR Policy and annual CSR activity reports.

articles.title: First Time in Mahakoshal – Advanced EBUS Technology Now Available at Apollo JBP Hospitals, Jabalpur
articles.excerpt: A historic milestone in pulmonary healthcare for Central India. Apollo JBP Hospitals proudly introduces EBUS (Endobronchial Ultrasound) in Jabalpur — the first time this advanced diagnostic technology is available in the Mahakoshal region.
articles.author: Apollo JBP Hospitals
content: Apollo JBP Hospitals has achieved a monumental healthcare milestone by introducing Endobronchial Ultrasound (EBUS) technology in Jabalpur for the very first time across the Mahakoshal region.

EBUS is a minimally invasive procedure that allows pulmonologists to perform real-time ultrasound imaging inside the lungs and mediastinum. It enables precise biopsy of lymph nodes and lung lesions without requiring open thoracic surgery.
1. **Minimally Invasive:** Performed under sedation via a specialized flexible bronchoscope.
2. **Short Recovery:** Many patients return home within hours, without surgical incision marks.
3. **Early Diagnosis:** Supports diagnosis of mediastinal lymph node enlargement, lung cancer staging, and complex pulmonary tuberculosis.

articles.title: Giant Bullae Treatment in Jabalpur – Advanced Bullectomy Surgery at Apollo JBP Hospitals
articles.excerpt: Are you experiencing shortness of breath, persistent cough, or chest pain? These symptoms could indicate Giant Bullae, large air-filled spaces in the lungs that can compress healthy tissue.
articles.author: Apollo JBP Hospitals
content: Giant Bullae are large air-filled spaces (dilated air sacs) in the lungs that can expand over a large part of the chest, compressing adjacent healthy lung tissue and impairing oxygen exchange.
- Progressive shortness of breath during routine physical activity.
- Chest tightness or recurrent pneumothorax (collapsed lung).

Bullectomy removes the non-functional giant bulla so that compressed healthy lung tissue can re-expand, helping restore breathing capacity. Consult our pulmonology and thoracic surgery team to find out whether surgery is right for you.

articles.title: Pediatric UTI Treatment in Jabalpur | Apollo JBP Hospitals, Jabalpur
articles.excerpt: Best Child UTI Specialist & Advanced Pediatric Care at Apollo JBP Hospitals. If your child has fever without cause, burning urination, or repeated urinary infection, prompt evaluation helps protect the kidneys.
articles.author: Apollo JBP Hospitals
content: Urinary Tract Infection (UTI) in infants and young children needs prompt diagnosis to avoid long-term kidney scarring.
1. High fever without obvious cold or cough symptoms.
2. Irritability, poor feeding, or vomiting in toddlers.
3. Burning sensation, foul-smelling urine, or frequent urination.
Evaluation can include urine culture, kidney ultrasound and, where advised by the specialist, further imaging such as a DMSA scan. Early, targeted treatment helps protect kidney health.

articles.title: Winter Joint Pain Treatment in Jabalpur – Expert Orthopedic Care at Apollo JBP Hospitals
articles.excerpt: Cold weather often leads to joint pain, stiffness, and reduced mobility, especially in winter. Many patients experience worsening knee pain, hip pain, shoulder pain, and arthritis pain during colder months.
articles.author: Apollo JBP Hospitals
content: Cold weather often leads to joint pain, stiffness, and reduced mobility, especially in winter. Many patients experience worsening knee pain, hip pain, shoulder pain, and arthritis pain during colder months.
### Why Joint Pain Can Worsen in Winter:
- Reduced blood circulation to the limbs in cold weather.
- Stiffer joints and muscles after long periods of inactivity.
- Reduced physical movement leading to muscle tightness.
- **Medical Management:** Pain relief and joint-protection treatment as advised by your orthopedic specialist.
- **Joint Replacement:** For advanced arthritis, speak to our Ortho-Joint and Spine team about surgical options.

articles.title: Winter Heart Care in Jabalpur: Protect Your Heart During Cold Weather
articles.excerpt: Winter does not only affect comfort—it directly impacts heart health, especially for people living with high blood pressure, heart disease, diabetes, or cholesterol problems. Cold weather increases strain on the heart.
articles.author: Apollo JBP Hospitals
content: Cardiovascular emergencies tend to rise during winter. Cold weather narrows blood vessels to conserve heat, which can raise blood pressure and heart rate.
1. **Dress in Layers:** Avoid sudden cold exposure when stepping outdoors early in the morning.
2. **Monitor Blood Pressure Regularly:** Consult your cardiologist if your readings are consistently high.
3. **Avoid Sudden Heavy Exertion:** Warm up indoors before strenuous outdoor activity.
4. **Know Who to Call:** For emergencies, call Apollo JBP Hospitals at 1800-123-6666.

articles.title: Stay Active, Not Sick: Best Flu Prevention & Treatment in Jabalpur
articles.excerpt: Seasonal flu is widespread during weather changes. Learn about flu vaccines, treatment, and immune-supporting habits at Apollo JBP Hospitals.
articles.author: Apollo JBP Hospitals
content: Seasonal influenza is a contagious viral respiratory infection that spreads rapidly during seasonal shifts. Symptoms include sudden high fever, severe muscle aches, dry cough, and tiredness.
- **Annual Flu Vaccine:** Recommended for children, older adults, and healthcare workers.
- **Hydration:** Warm fluids keep the throat and airways comfortable.
- **Prompt Medical Evaluation:** Helps tell viral flu apart from secondary bacterial chest infections.

articles.title: Dry Eye Treatment in Jabalpur: Why Blurry Vision Increases During Winter
articles.excerpt: Blurry vision and eye irritation often increase during dry winter months. Learn about the causes of dry eye and when to see an eye specialist.
articles.author: Apollo JBP Hospitals
content: Low humidity and indoor heating during winter speed up tear evaporation from the eye surface, which can lead to Meibomian Gland Dysfunction (MGD) and dry eye syndrome.
- Burning, stinging, or grittiness in the eyes.
- Fluctuating blurry vision that improves after blinking.
- Excessive watering of the eyes (a reflex response to dryness).
An eye specialist can evaluate your tear film and advise lubricating drops or other suitable treatment.
